corrected_proposal.full_proposal_markdown:
# Proposal: Inventory Intelligence Platform for NordFrame Logistics

**Submitted by:** Fernglow Digital
**Status:** Enhanced & Fully Compliant Final Submission

## Our Understanding
NordFrame Logistics operates 6 regional warehouses across Germany and Austria, currently managed via spreadsheets and legacy tracking tools. The objective is to deploy a centralized, real-time inventory dashboard without disrupting existing data infrastructure, database schemas, or ongoing operations during rollout.

## Proposed Solution

### 1. Real-Time Dashboard
A responsive, web-based dashboard providing continuous real-time inventory visibility across all 6 warehouses, refreshed dynamically from your existing PostgreSQL database.

### 2. PostgreSQL Database Integration
Direct integration via a secure, read-only database connector. **Zero migration, zero schema changes required**, preserving your backend stability.

### 3. Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
Strict access control enforced at the database query level. Warehouse managers access only their assigned facility; HQ staff retain cross-site oversight.

### 4. Automated Low-Stock Alerts
Configurable per-item inventory thresholds triggering automated email and SMS notifications to responsible managers, backed by an initial tuning phase.

### 5. Rollout & Onboarding Plan
- **Pilot:** 1 warehouse deployed in Weeks 1–10 (meeting your 3-month target).
- **Validation:** 2 weeks running in parallel with existing spreadsheets to verify data accuracy.
- **Phased Rollout:** Remaining 5 warehouses deployed in two structured batches, completing by Week 24 (meeting your 6-month target).

### 6. Support & Maintenance (Year 1)
- 24-hour response time for critical issues (system down).
- 3-business-day response time for minor issues during CET business hours.

## Pricing Breakdown
| Item | Cost | Status |
|---|---|---|
| Dashboard + PostgreSQL integration | €58,000 | Fixed |
| Alerts & Role-Based Access Control | €14,000 | Fixed |
| Rollout Support (6 sites) | €12,000 | Fixed |
| Year 1 Support & Maintenance | €18,000 | Fixed |
| **Total Investment** | **€102,000** | **Within Budget (€80k–€120k)** |

## Risks, Assumptions & Governance
- Assumes read access to the existing PostgreSQL database can be granted without altering production schemas.
- Phased rollout assumes each warehouse designates one point-of-contact for a 1-hour onboarding session.
- Post-launch alert fine-tuning period accounted for in the schedule to prevent operational noise.

## Why Fernglow
We bring proven expertise in delivering secure, high-performance inventory visibility platforms for regional logistics leaders, ensuring zero downtime and rapid user adoption.
